annotations.title: Network activity and the x402 part, over the same days

description: WHAT EACH NETWORK CARRIED, AND THE x402 PART BESIDE IT. Per network and in totals, over a day, week, month, quarter and year: chain transactions, active addresses (a daily average beyond a week) and DEX volume from public sources (growthepie, Blockscout for Gnosis and Arc, DefiLlama; Solana transactions from its RPC’s per-minute performance samples, its active addresses only a floor), set beside the stablecoin transfers we index on x402 rails. LEAD WITH THE TIERS (since 2026-11-27): `says` and each window’s transactions_with_x402_by_tier give confirmed_protocol, inferred_facilitator, candidate_catalogue and unknown, summing to the total; most are catalogue candidates, compatible with x402 and not proof, and none is evidence of an agent. Read transactions_with_x402_candidate, x402_candidate_payer_addresses and x402_candidate_volume_usd; agentTx, agentTxShare, agentActive, agentVolumeUsd, agentVolumeVsDex and agentCoverage are DEPRECATED aliases with the same values (`deprecated` maps them). With chain=, the daily series too. THREE CAVEATS TO QUOTE: (1) `agentVolumeVsDex` is agentVolumeSameDays / dexVolumeSameDays, both summed over the SAME days, agentObservedStart to agentObservedEnd, the days our x402 index was reading; `dexVolumeUsd` is the whole window and is not its denominator. `agentVolumeVsDexBasis` says same_days, partial_window or none, and `agentCoverage` how much of the window was observed. Over one network the totals equal the network. (2) Payment volume and DEX trading are two different activities: a comparison, never a share. (3) x402 is not all agent activity: ACP, Olas and payments we cannot tie to x402 are not in it. Agent payers are set beside active addresses, never as a share (a payer signs, a facilitator sends). A network a source does not cover is null, never zero. `coverage` names the population (network_activity_days). Free.

chain.description: One network, e.g. ethereum or base; adds the daily series. Omit for every network.

name: network_activity

asOf.description: The end day, null where nothing has been read.

coverage.description: population network_activity_days, networks, chainSide, agentSide x402_payments, agentSince, agentSideSays, comparison.

deprecated.description: since, fields (old agent* name → new name), means.

endDay.description: The last complete day the windows end on (each network ends on its own last counted day, `windowEndDay`).

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

networks.description: Per network: chain, windowEndDay, window (its own 24-hour requested/covered/backlog), windows[] (window, days, txCount, txCountBasis (source_daily; on Solana performance_samples or scaled_from_sampled_minutes), txCountCoveredSeconds, activeAddressesLowerBound (Solana: distinct fee payers in sampled blocks, a floor, never in activeAddresses or the totals), transactions_with_x402_candidate, transactions_with_x402_candidate_share, transactions_with_x402_by_tier, x402_candidate_payer_addresses, x402_candidate_payer_addresses_by_tier (day only), x402_candidate_volume_usd, x402_volume_usd_by_tier, x402_candidate_volume_vs_dex, x402_index_coverage; deprecated aliases agentTx, agentTxShare, agentActive, agentVolumeUsd, agentVolumeVsDex, agentCoverage; agentTxBasis, activeAddresses, dexVolumeUsd, agentVolumeVsDexMeans, agentVolumeVsDexBasis, agentVolumeSameDays, dexVolumeSameDays, periodStart, periodEnd, agentObservedStart, agentObservedEnd), sourcesCovered, and with chain= the daily series.

says.description: The answer in a sentence: "Partial: ..." first where the window is not complete, then the last complete day’s transactions by evidence tier, confirmed first, and the day they run to.

totals.description: Across networks, by window, with the same same-days ratio and period fields as each network.

totalsMeans.description: How the totals add: an address active on two networks counts twice.

uniquesAt.description: When the unique-payer windows were counted.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

window.description: The window asked for against the window read for the 24 hours (2026-11-27): over the networks with a transaction source, the day ending endDay; backlog carries the days each lacks; notCovered names the networks with no transaction source at all: state complete | partial | not_read, requested {from, to, seconds}, covered {from, to, seconds} or null, coveredShare, watermark (how far the slowest source is read), backlog [{chain, seconds, fromStart?}] (unread end and start per network), firstLine. Where state is not complete, `says` starts with firstLine ("Partial: ..."); counts in the unread part are missing, not zero.
